env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cfg$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/cfg$GOEXE
stdout '^zero: 0 "" logos: 8080 "localhost"$'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/cfg/cfg.lgo --
package cfg

import "fmt"

type Cfg struct {
	Port int = 8080
	Host string = "localhost"
}

func FromLogos() string {
	c := Cfg{}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d %q", c.Port, c.Host)
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/cfg"
)

func Run() string {
	c := cfg.Cfg{}
	return fmt.Sprintf("zero: %d %q logos: %s", c.Port, c.Host, cfg.FromLogos())
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(q.Run()) }
